```{r}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(gemstools)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(patchwork)
library(here)

# Configure targets to look in parent directory
tar_config_set(store = here("_targets"))

tar_load(rga_adv_flux)
tar_load(hourly_stats)
tar_load(rga_oxygen)
tar_load(seaphox_df_jul)
tar_load(proco2_df_jul)
tar_load(oxygen_calibration_mode)
tar_load(co2_calibration_mode)
tar_load(ox_cal_df)
tar_load(ox_cal_df_high)
tar_load(ox_cal_df_mean)
tar_load(co2_cal_df)
tar_load(co2_cal_df_high)
tar_load(co2_cal_df_mean)
tar_load(ox_model)
tar_load(ox_model_high)
tar_load(ox_model_mean)
tar_load(co2_model)
tar_load(co2_model_high)
tar_load(co2_model_mean)
```

# Calibration mode

```{r}
tibble(
  gas = c("oxygen", "co2"),
  calibration_mode = c(oxygen_calibration_mode, co2_calibration_mode)
)
```

# Method comparison

```{r}
summarize_calibration <- function(df, model, response, predictor, mode, gas) {
  complete_df <- df |>
    filter(!is.na(.data[[response]]), !is.na(.data[[predictor]]))

  tibble(
    gas = gas,
    mode = mode,
    n = nrow(complete_df),
    intercept = unname(coef(model)[1]),
    slope = unname(coef(model)[2]),
    r_squared = summary(model)$r.squared,
    residual_se = summary(model)$sigma
  )
}

bind_rows(
  summarize_calibration(
    ox_cal_df_high,
    ox_model_high,
    "seaphox_oxygen_umol_l",
    "mass_32_40",
    "high",
    "oxygen"
  ),
  summarize_calibration(
    ox_cal_df_mean,
    ox_model_mean,
    "seaphox_oxygen_umol_l",
    "mass_32_40",
    "mean",
    "oxygen"
  ),
  summarize_calibration(
    co2_cal_df_high,
    co2_model_high,
    "prooceanus_co2_umol_l",
    "mass_44_40",
    "high",
    "co2"
  ),
  summarize_calibration(
    co2_cal_df_mean,
    co2_model_mean,
    "prooceanus_co2_umol_l",
    "mass_44_40",
    "mean",
    "co2"
  )
) |>
  arrange(gas, mode)
```

# Oxygen

```{r}
summary(ox_model)
om <- ox_model$coefficients[2]
oi <- ox_model$coefficients[1]

```

```{r}
ox_cal_df <- ox_cal_df |>
  mutate(
    rga_ox = mass_32_40 * om + oi
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(seaphox_oxygen_umol_l),
    !is.na(rga_ox)
  )
```

```{r}
cal_plot_df <- ox_cal_df

cal_plot_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(seaphox_oxygen_umol_l, rga_ox),
    names_to = "source",
    values_to = "oxygen_umol_l"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(timestamp, oxygen_umol_l, color = source)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Calibration timeseries", x = NULL, y = "Oxygen [umol/l]")
```

  1:1 plots of fit

```{r}
ggplot(cal_plot_df, aes(mass_32_40, seaphox_oxygen_umol_l)) +
  geom_abline(slope = om, intercept = oi) +
  geom_point(
    shape = 1,
    color = "blue",
    size = 2,
    stroke = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Calibration fit",
    x = "GEMS 32:40",
    y = "Optode oxygen [umol/l]"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(cal_plot_df, aes(seaphox_oxygen_umol_l, rga_ox)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
  geom_point(
    shape = 1,
    color = "blue",
    size = 2,
    stroke = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Calibration fit",
    x = "Optode oxygen [umol/l]",
    y = "GEMS oxygen [umol/l]"
  )
```

```{r}
bind_rows(
  ox_cal_df_high |> mutate(mode = "high"),
  ox_cal_df_mean |> mutate(mode = "mean")
) |>
  ggplot(aes(mass_32_40, seaphox_oxygen_umol_l, color = mode)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Oxygen calibration comparison",
    x = "GEMS 32:40",
    y = "Optode oxygen [umol/l]"
  )
```


# CO2

Compare ProCO2 and RGA

```{r}
summary(co2_model)
cm <- co2_model$coefficients[2]
ci <- co2_model$coefficients[1]
```

```{r}
co2_cal_df <- co2_cal_df |>
  mutate(
```
